facts.heading: Marriage ended after fifteen years
facts.content: Jana's marriage to Radko ended after fifteen years.
facts.evidence: After fifteen years of marriage, my husband Radko and I decided on a divorce

facts.heading: Divorce announcement in September
facts.content: Radko told Jana in September that the marriage could not continue.
facts.evidence: in September he told me that it couldn't go on like this

facts.heading: Jana's emotional reactions
facts.content: Jana experiences feelings of emptiness and anger several times a day.
facts.evidence: Emptiness, then anger, then emptiness again. It happens several times a day

facts.heading: Radko's reason for divorce
facts.content: Radko stated that the couple drifted apart and lived next to each other.
facts.evidence: He says that we drifted apart, that we live next to each other

facts.heading: Jana's self-blame regarding marriage
facts.content: Jana feels she should have noticed the signs of the drifting apart.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I was blind

facts.heading: Jana's uncertainty about fault
facts.content: Jana wonders if she was too tired or if she cared too much.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired, I didn't care about him.

facts.heading: Children's names and ages
facts.content: Jana has two children: Anička, who is 12, and Matěj, who is 8.
facts.evidence: I have two children, Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8

facts.heading: Decision to tell children
facts.content: Jana and Radko have not told the children about the divorce yet.
facts.evidence: No. Radek wants us to tell them together, or we postpone it

facts.heading: Anička suspects fighting
facts.content: Anička asked Jana if she and her father were fighting last week.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if Dad and I are fighting

facts.heading: Jana lied to Anička
facts.content: Jana lied to Anička about the fighting, and Anička found out.
facts.evidence: Because I lied. And she found out

facts.heading: Jana's fear regarding children
facts.content: Jana is afraid of her children's tears regarding the divorce.
facts.evidence: I am afraid of her tears

facts.heading: Housing situation details
facts.content: The house is on a mortgage, and Radko will likely move in with his brother.
facts.evidence: The house is on a mortgage, Radek is probably moving in with his brother

facts.heading: Custody arrangement
facts.content: The children will stay with Jana.
facts.evidence: The child will stay with me

facts.heading: Jana's concern about finances
facts.content: Jana is afraid she cannot manage the situation alone because Radko handled the money.
facts.evidence: I am afraid I won't manage it alone. Radek would always deal with the money.

facts.heading: Job as Czech teacher in Brno
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher in an elementary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher in an elementary school in Brno

facts.heading: Teaches nine and eight year olds
facts.content: Jana teaches nine-year-olds and eight-year-olds.
facts.evidence: I teach nine-year-olds and eight-year-olds

facts.heading: Feels life is falling apart
facts.content: Jana feels everyone sees that her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I have the feeling that everyone sees that my life is falling apart

facts.heading: Principal knows about situation
facts.content: Only the principal at Jana's school knows about her situation.
facts.evidence: Only the principal

facts.heading: Principal allowed early leave
facts.content: The principal allowed Jana to leave early when she cried in the hallway.
facts.evidence: That she let me leave early

facts.heading: Worse when alone at home
facts.content: Jana felt worse when she was alone at home compared to being at work.
facts.evidence: But then I sat at home and it was worse

facts.heading: Sleeps badly every night
facts.content: Jana sleeps badly every night.
facts.evidence: Badly

facts.heading: Wakes at three AM thinking
facts.content: Jana wakes up at three in the morning thinking about the future.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at three in the morning and think about what will happen next

facts.heading: Worries about finances and children
facts.content: Jana worries about not having a mortgage, not having a husband, and how to tell the children about finances.
facts.evidence: That I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a husband, I don't have anything. Then I calculate the money, then I imagine how I will tell the children

facts.heading: Sleep pattern details
facts.content: Jana falls asleep around five and wakes up at half past seven.
facts.evidence: I fall asleep around five and wake up at half past seven

facts.heading: Weight loss and friend's comment
facts.content: Jana has lost four kilos and a friend told her she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: I've lost four kilos. A friend tells me I look terrible

facts.heading: Support from sister and friend
facts.content: Jana has her sister Alana in Olomouc, who calls her almost every evening, and a friend Eva from work.
facts.evidence: I have my sister Alana in Olomouc. She calls me almost every evening. And a friend Eva from work

facts.heading: Tells Eva about difficult period
facts.content: Jana tells Eva that she is having a difficult period, but does not want Eva to think anything about her.
facts.evidence: To Eva just that I am having a difficult period. I don't want her to think anything about me

facts.heading: Fear of being judged by Eva
facts.content: Jana fears Eva might think that a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children

facts.heading: Belief from mother about marriage
facts.content: Jana believes her mom always said that marriage holds together and children want what they want.
facts.evidence: She always said that marriage holds together and children want what they want

facts.heading: Mother's reaction to Jana
facts.content: Jana's mom was silent after Jana told her, and then said she hopes Jana thought about it well.
facts.evidence: She was silent. Then she said that she hopes I thought about it well

facts.heading: Need for mother's approval
facts.content: Jana stated she would need her mom to approve of her.
facts.evidence: I would need her to approve of me

facts.heading: Stated family norm about loneliness
facts.content: Jana stated that wanting not to be alone is not done in her family.
facts.evidence: That it hurts that I don't want to be alone, but that's not done in our family

facts.heading: Crying and apologizing when speaking
facts.content: When Jana says things out loud, she cries and apologizes.
facts.evidence: I cry and apologize

facts.heading: Needs sleep and plan for children
facts.content: Jana feels that sleeping and knowing how to tell the children would help her most right now.
facts.evidence: Sleeping and knowing how to tell the children

facts.heading: Uses chamomile tea for sleep
facts.content: Jana uses chamomile tea to aid her sleep.
facts.evidence: Chamomile tea and that's it

facts.heading: Refuses doctor's pills
facts.content: Jana does not want to take pills offered by the doctor.
facts.evidence: I don't want them

facts.heading: Fear of missing children
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't be able to wake up in time for the children.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't be able to wake up in time for the children

facts.heading: Fear of addiction
facts.content: Jana does not want to become addicted to medication.
facts.evidence: I don't want to be addicted

facts.heading: Willingness to write down worries
facts.content: Jana is willing to write down her worries to get them out of her head.
facts.evidence: I could, but at least I get it out of my head

facts.heading: Fear of panic and crying
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will cry with panic and won't be able to stay calm.
facts.evidence: That I'll cry with panic, that I won't be able to stay calm

facts.heading: Concern for children seeing crying
facts.content: Jana is worried about her children seeing her cry.
facts.evidence: That I would cry in front of the children

facts.heading: Anička is sensitive
facts.content: Jana believes Anička is sensitive.
facts.evidence: Anička is sensitive

facts.heading: Test today is not alone
facts.content: Jana's test today is that she is not alone and doesn't have to manage things right away.
facts.evidence: That I am not alone and that I don't have to manage it right away
